notes: Programme pages on uni-heidelberg.de state only language of instruction; the real admission rules sit in German-only admission-regulation PDFs (not readable) and, where quoted, on faculty or programme sites. Most deadlines are written without a year (Physics: 15 July / 15 January non-EU, 30 September / 31 March EU; Economics 30 September; Scientific Computing winter non-EU 15 June recommended, 31 July internal; TMR 15 March; central table at uni-heidelberg.de key-dates page), so only Molecular Biosciences (15 March 2027) is recorded. MMLDS page lists the winter 2026/27 window (1 Feb - 15 Mar 2026), already past. Central international-admission accordion text (non-EU deadlines, APS) is not in the page HTML. Physics, Data and Computer Science (requirements page says its listed criteria are for the old regulations), Political Science: requirements are in PDFs only. APS for China, India, Vietnam is stated by Scientific Computing, Molecular Biosciences and TMR pages. Computational Linguistics site is robots-blocked. Health and Society in South Asia is not in the university's programme list (South Asian Studies replaces the older South Asia master from WS 2026/27). Skipped: continuing-education and Master of Education variants. Unreached: Biochemistry, Molecular Biotechnology, Molecular Systems Science, Biomedical Engineering and the German-taught humanities masters.
